d.j: The user is explicitly asking for a phone number to move communication outside the platform.

d.seg: நீ அமௌன்ட் பே பண்ற மாதிரி இருக்கும்
d.tr: You will have to pay an amount
d.j: The user is requesting payment for a service in a context that suggests an external transaction.

d.seg: நீ எப்ப வேணாலும் இந்த நம்பருக்கு கால் பண்ணலாம்
d.tr: You can call this number anytime
d.j: The user is offering to share a phone number for external communication.
